subject: Voyager Analytics POC — Acceptance criteria & API playbook
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@voyageranalytics.com>, Dave Liu <dave.liu@voyageranalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Voyager Analytics — POC post-demo recap and next steps

Hi Elena / Dave,

Thanks again for the demo today — super productive. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we push an internal kickoff at Voyager. TL;DR: agreed POC scope, initial success metrics, and a suggested 3-week tech sprint to validate API + streaming integration.

Scope (what we’ll validate):
- Low-latency text-generation for customer support triage (100–200 RPS burst, 99th pct latency < 250ms)
- Chat + tool-calling path: ability to invoke a downstream ticketing webhook from model response
- SDK-based streaming client for frontend prototype (websocket variant)

Initial success criteria (suggested):
- Accuracy: intent classification F1 >= 0.84 on your 500-sample eval set
- Latency: median < 120ms, p99 < 250ms under steady-state 50 RPS
- Cost: token unit cost target < $0.003 per response for the evaluated load profile
- Reliability: <1% failed responses over 24h soak test

Owners & timeline proposal:
- Week 0 (this week): mutual action plan signed, procurement kickoff (Voyager proc / Sean)
- Week 1: SE integration sprint — SDK + API route wiring (Ben owner)
- Week 2: End-to-end test + eval set run (Marissa + Voyager data owner)
- Week 3: Acceptance window and final metrics review (Naomi owner for Redwood overall acceptance)

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (draft), voyager_poc-success-metrics.xlsx (template). Ben will drop the SDK snippets and streaming notes in a follow-up.

Next actions for today:
1) Elena — confirm procurement contact and preferred PO cadence (reply to all)
2) Dave — share the 500-sample eval set (anonymized) or a drive link
3) Ben — post minimal SDK streaming sample and proposed API routes by EOW

Thanks — I’ll calendar a 30-min kickoff for Monday if we have procurement clarity.

—
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voyager Analytics — POC post-demo recap and next steps (integration notes)

Elena / team — jumping in with the technical plan and API/SDK notes you asked for. High level: we’ll provide a minimal SDK (browser + node) that supports streaming over WebSocket and chunked HTTP (EventStream). For server-side test harnessing, we’ll expose a protected test API key with scoped token expiry.

Proposed API surface (minimal):
1) POST /v1/generate (sync) — JSON body: {model, prompt, max_tokens, temperature} — returns full response
2) POST /v1/stream (streaming) — upgrade to websocket or SSE; sends incremental token frames; includes 'first_token_time' in header for handshake latency measurement
3) POST /v1/toolcall (webhook) — accepts model-invoked actions; Redwood will forward verified toolcall payloads to a configured URL with HMAC signature

SDK snippets (attached):
- browser/stream.js: websocket connect + backpressure handling
- node/sse.js: EventSource client for server tests
- server/hmac-verification.md: how the webhook HMAC is validated

Security notes: token scopes will be limited to the POC project; we recommend short TTL tokens (1h) for client-side streaming. If you need stricter isolation we can provision a dedicated model pool in Dedicated later in the POC.

Action items I’m taking:
- Drop the SDK zip and a 15-min code sample into the shared Drive by EOD (done)
- Provide a small perf harness to reproduce median/p99 metrics locally (Tues)

On quoting Sean below for ownership and timeline.

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 11:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Voyager Analytics — POC post-demo recap and next steps (acceptance gating)

Elena / team — adding acceptance gating and what we’ll measure during the Week 2 eval. If helpful I can run an automated job against your shared eval set and post a report to the Drive.

Acceptance gating (Week 3 window):
- Functional: tool-calling end-to-end exercised with 20 representative flows (pass/fail)
- Quality: F1 >= 0.84 on the eval set + qualitative review for high-severity misclassifications
- Performance: measured under a 50 RPS sustained run for 30 minutes AND a 200 RPS 2-minute burst. Capture median/p95/p99 and first-token handshake.
- Observability: traces for model calls and webhook deliveries, plus error budgets defined (<1% failed responses)

Owners:
- SE integration + routing (Ben)
- Eval runs + report (Marissa)
- Acceptance sign-off (Naomi)

Schedule note: if Voyager prefers kickoff on 11/15, we’ll target the Week 2 eval run during 11/22–11/24 and have sign-off session 11/29. If procurement needs more time we can shift by a week.

Thanks — I’ll drop the runbook into Drive and schedule the perf window.

Marissa
Principal Customer Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Appreciate the thorough plan — we’re aligned on scope and timeline. A couple of follow-ups from our infra/security side:
1) Token scoping: can you confirm the streaming tokens will only be usable for the POC project and cannot be used against other Redwood projects? We need assurance on token project scoping.

Thanks Dave — good questions. Quick answers inline and confirmation:

1) Token scoping: yes, POC tokens will be project-scoped; they will be provisioned to the Voyager project namespace and not usable outside that namespace. We’ll include token TTL and rotation details in the SOW.

2) Webhook verification: Ben attached the HMAC verification doc — Redwood will sign callbacks and provide rotation guidance. We can support a shared secret or an HMAC with per-request timestamp.

3) Data retention: default POC log retention will be 60 days unless you request otherwise; we will not keep payloads beyond anonymized metadata for observability. Security will send a short statement for your legal team.

Kickoff: Monday 15 Nov 2027 at 10:00am PT confirmed. I’ll create a calendar invite and link the Drive folder.
